regions.finding: The existing 3a-to-4 and 3a-to-5 records were enriched with the displayed TfOH/trimethyl-phosphate/toluene or AuCl3/[nBuMIM]PF6 conditions and product yields 66% and 68%. The two arrows remain distinct experiments.

Three distinct controls were enriched: divided-cell 0% 3a/35% anodic benzaldehyde; excess oxoammonium/cat 1 in DMF at room temperature for 24 h giving benzaldehyde 91% and no 3a; and benzaldehyde electrolysis at 18 mA for 3 h at 0 °C giving 3a in 60%.

The n-BuLi control was split into ordered stages: 1a (1.0 mmol) with n-BuLi/THF at -20 °C for 1 h, then PhCHO (0.5 mmol) for 1 h. The combined 58% outcome and 3a/3a' = 1/1.5 ratio target both products; the second-stage temperature remains missing.

The eight displayed C-H pKa values in DMF (sites a-h) were retained in a separate mechanism/calculation record. This region is not a reported reaction experiment and the compact model structures remain label-only.

The intramolecular 20 min competition and separate parallel KIE experiment were kept distinct. Standard electrolysis context was linked from Table 1, while ~1.5/1.0 and ~2.0/1.0 KIE results and the 0.60 D product content were retained as printed.

Three separate catalyst controls were enriched: cat 1 (1 equiv)/TEMPO (20 mol%) without electricity for 24 h gives 0%; species A (5 mol%) under N2 electrolysis gives 64%; species B (5 mol%) gives trace product. The source's trace result replaces the earlier prose-only no-product approximation.
The complete cathodic HER/anodic TEMPO cycle was classified as mechanism and represented as ordered proposed operations. A-F, carbanion D, and aldehyde G were not promoted to isolated experiments.
